Description: As a system analyst I want to define the functional specifications of the RAG assistant so that system behavior is clear.
Collect and prepare 5-10 public college policy documents (academic regulations examination handbook placement rules).
Create evaluation dataset with 50 questions across Category A (Direct) Category B (Paraphrased) and Category C (Unanswerable).
Setup local LLM runtime and dependencies on developer workstation.
Verify model downloading and baseline test generation.

As a system developer I want to extract text from uploaded PDF documents so that their contents can be processed by the RAG system. Acceptance Criteria: 1. Accepts PDF 2. Readable pages extracted 3. Retain filename 4. Empty pages do not crash.
As a developer I want to split large documents into chunks of 1500 chars with 200 char overlap so that relevant sections reach the context window.
As a developer I want to convert text chunks into vector embeddings using nomic-embed-text and cloud-native embedders.
As a developer I want to store chunk embeddings and metadata in persistent ChromaDB so that persistent vector search is enabled.

As a user I want the system to retrieve document sections related to my question so that the LLM receives relevant information. Acceptance Criteria: 1. Question converted to embedding 2. Vector DB searched 3. Top chunks returned 4. Source preserved.

As a student I want to ask questions in natural language so that I can easily understand college documents. Acceptance Criteria: 1. Enter question 2. Chunks retrieved 3. Provided to LLM 4. Generates understandable answer 5. Grounded in context 6. Source displayed.
Engineer system prompt enforcing strict adherence to retrieved context and preventing hallucination.
Display source document name and page number alongside generated answer.

As a user I want the application to indicate when information is unavailable so that I am not provided with fabricated information. Acceptance Criteria: Return 'Information not found in the available documents.' when evidence is absent.
Design clean web interface with query input answer display source citations and document management.
Add expandable UI accordion showing exact retrieved chunks and similarity metrics.

Summary: Cloud deployment configuration for Streamlit Cloud
Description: Configure production deployment files secrets management and repository-backed persistence for cloud deployment on Streamlit Community Cloud.
Integrate official Anthropic Python SDK support claude-3-5-sonnet and claude-3-5-haiku handle rate limits timeouts and secret management.
Execute unit tests on loader chunker retriever Claude service and full RAG pipeline using pytest.
Run benchmark on 50 questions calculating Retrieval Accuracy Safe Refusal Rate and 5-metric scoring.
Resolve telemetry warnings chunk boundary edge cases and refine prompt for paraphrased queries.
Compile final project report Jira tracking logs architecture diagrams and presentation slides.
